items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: And there was actually a singing duo at the time that I remember very distinctly called Mickey and Sylvia.

ctx.x: Oh, this is a true story.

It is a true story, really, yeah. Well I liked baseball too. Maybe I just got confused in my playing. Do I want to play baseball or guitar? Well let’s use the guitar as a baseball bat. And we can sort of do two things. But once I got an electric guitar I think I was kind of like bitten by the sound. There was something about this sound coming from the speaker, more than an acoustic instrument. It was just something really exciting and very electric about it, it was an electric guitar.
